description: ahaslides-design plugin hooks — the agent entry point shipped with the AhaSlides design system (@ahaslides-product/design), which owns every rule and judge criterion. UserPromptSubmit (prompt-mandate.sh) fires on every prompt: always the 'AhaSlides UI => the DS is mandatory, load the aha-design skill' mandate, plus the DS anti-slop surfaces when the hook detects a UI signal, plus, on a settings signal (settings, preferences, a toggle, an options dialog, slide type config), the hard line 'settings design task => load ahaslides-design:settings-design before planning or writing anything, no exception'. PreToolUse (design-guard.sh) names the DS surface a write touches (block a raw table, a forbidden icon set, or a hand-made icon — an inline <svg> in a .tsx/.jsx/.vue/.svelte/.astro file (or a .ts/.js/.html file in a project that depends on the DS package; test files exempt) or a new .svg file outside the DS — pointing at the DS icon search; block a raw <button>, role=button or <aha-button size=xl> added to a build-less slide type's presenter.* / audience.* file, .html included, unless the line carries ds-lint-allow: raw-button (why); block a write to settings UI (a build-less slide type's settings.* file, or a file a rule routes to the settings surface; test files exempt) until the session transcript shows the settings-design skill was loaded (a Skill call or a read of its SKILL.md, in the session or one of its sub-agents), fail-open when the transcript is missing or unreadable, AHA_DESIGN_SETTINGS_SKILL_DISABLE=1 turns off only this block; nudge the rest) with that surface's criteria. A build-less slide type's files are presenter / audience / settings .html and .js in a folder where one of those pages loads ahaslides-design@ from the CDN or the aha-slide-plugin SDK (slide_type.py), with or without a package.json or a src/ folder. Stop: slop-guard.sh runs impeccable's craft-floor detector over touched frontend files; design-judge-stop.sh asks for the DS judge on the uncommitted UI files changed this turn, a build-less slide type's files included (presenter.* on canvas, audience.* on audience, settings.* on settings), and for a changed settings file also demands the settings-design label self-check table (label | 'Changing this ...' sentence | tooltip) (set AHA_DESIGN_JUDGE_DISABLE=1 to skip). Criteria come from anti-slop/criteria.json in the installed package, else the plugin's own copy from the same release (see ds_criteria.py). In a legacy Vue 2 project (nearest package.json declares vue 2.x) the hooks apply to new files only (untracked or added in the working diff), built with the DS <aha-*> web components and never the storybook kit; they stay silent on edits to existing files, which are changed only when the task asks. All fail-open. Every hook records one heartbeat line per run to .impeccable/firing-log.jsonl, including which criteria source it used, so a silent hook is detectable — read it with hooks/firing_status.py.
